definitions.gloss: padded sleeping kimono; large kimono-shaped bedcover
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese oversized, thickly padded garment shaped like a kimono, used as a bedcover or sleeping wrap. Historically used before modern futons and blankets became standard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夜着|よぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother used a padded sleeping kimono in winter.
People in the old days slept with a padded sleeping kimono draped over the futon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{民俗|みんぞく}→民俗：13238_minzoku⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧{夜着|よぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もので、⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{刺繍|ししゅう}→刺繍：05411_shishuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}されていた→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧。
examples.english: The padded sleeping kimono on display at the folk museum was from the Edo period and had beautiful embroidery.

notes:
An item of traditional Japanese bedding. The {夜着|よぎ} looks like an extremely large, heavily padded kimono with wide sleeves and is worn over or placed on top of the body while sleeping. It predates the modern ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧ (comforter) and was especially common in the Edo period through early Showa era.

In modern Japanese, the word is mostly encountered in historical literature, folk museums, and traditional craft contexts. Some modern products styled after the traditional {夜着|よぎ} are sold as novelty sleepwear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜着|よぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける: to drape a sleeping kimono over oneself
- ⟦{綿入|わたい}れ→綿入れ：21191_wataire⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜着|よぎ}: cotton-padded sleeping kimono
- {夜着|よぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{包|くる}まる: to wrap oneself in a sleeping kimono

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寝巻|ねま}き: sleepwear, nightclothes — general term for what one wears to bed
- ⟦パジャマ→パジャマ：04516_pajama⟧: pajamas — modern Western-style sleepwear
- ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧: comforter, duvet — the modern replacement for the {夜着|よぎ}
